describes: Current annotation engine drafts/patches, nested public nouns, text, resources, stamps and measurement host seam.

cases.name: draft-changed-per-draft
cases.covers: Current state-derived draft events track an actual move gesture; unchanged/foreign-page samples keep the gesture safe.

cases.name: page-space-reads
cases.covers: get/list return complete current engine records, filtered by pages/subtype; getAt and current nested selection/tools read actual public nouns.

cases.name: create-from-page-space
cases.covers: Each kind is created with its actual engine draft; named tool defaults and flattened flags survive, invalid geometry/unknown tools/unsupported kinds refuse.

cases.name: create-without-authority
cases.covers: Current create/from-selection/resource creation refuse without create authority, while pointer/markup doors stay inert and twins remain truthful.

cases.name: update-in-page-space
cases.covers: Current engine field patches update each shape family and rich bodies; bad geometry, absent refs, locks and engine refusals stay explicit.

cases.name: selection-verbs
cases.covers: Nested selectAll/selectInRect/rotate/reset/update/delete use actual current contracts and whole-change batch results.

cases.name: set-contents-settles-with-the-engine
cases.covers: Explicit current contents/richText patches settle with their own refused engine writes.

cases.name: text-range-needs-an-active-edit
cases.covers: Current selection properties read range styles only while editing a nonempty text selection.

cases.name: rich-text-editing
cases.covers: Current rich editor holds expose paragraphs immediately; range changes, format toggles and text.end drive actual engine patches.

cases.name: attachments-stamps-and-downloads
cases.covers: Current resource-separated create, downloadResource and stamps.place use complete drafts/resources; junk and absent pages refuse.

cases.name: measurement-distance-drafts
cases.covers: Distance creation needs loaded viewport scales, retains the first scale through its offset stage, and calibration captures without creating.

cases.name: dimension-drafts-continue-without-viewports
cases.covers: Perimeter and distance drafts continue on their own page after viewport withdrawal; another page cannot steal a draft.

cases.name: calibration-needs-modify
cases.covers: The current calibration capture needs doc.annotate.modify even when create is allowed.

cases.name: remeasure-page
cases.covers: Recalibration reports actual updated, locked, foreign-measure and engine-refused records; other pages stay isolated.

cases.name: remeasure-without-authority-and-after-errors
cases.covers: No-authority dimensions are reported as skipped; an unreadable mirror reports its failure rather than a silent successful calibration.

error.name: EngineError
error.message: the annotations of this document are not loaded

cases.name: v3-document-events
cases.covers: The current document.versioned event reloads the flat annotation mirror; annotation restores cause page-specific reloads and keep prior data on failure.

cases.name: finish-drafts-and-the-edit-hub
cases.covers: Nested draft.finish returns a real confirmed polygon; finish with none returns null and cancel clears another draft.

cases.name: awaited-writes-and-pending-text
cases.covers: A refused quarter-turn rejects its own promise; text deletion synchronously forgets its editor; file-picker removal keeps only the current provider.

cases.name: stamp-preview-providers
cases.covers: Current stamps.arm and renderArmedStampPreview cache real scripted providers by size bucket, including an explicit failed-preview callback.
